item.title: VHEMT as a philosophical lens, not as demographic proof
item.lead: The VHEMT link is most convincing when treated as a philosophical mirror.

blocks.text: VHEMT can help in reflecting on voluntary reproductive choices, but the step from that philosophy to a claim of "machine sterility" requires empirical evidence. The new edition separates these two layers.

However, the research can investigate whether digital substitutes influence certain forms of partner-seeking behavior. This requires research into time expenditure, expectations, relationship formation, and any substitution effects, controlling for income, age, education, housing costs, and social networks.

blocks.label: METHODOLOGICAL DISTINCTION
blocks.text: Philosophical compatibility is not causal empirical confirmation.
